title: OIDC provider templates
description: Templates for the dropdown "Vorlage" on the page to create an OIDC provider (resources/provider-templates.json). A template holds only the values that are the same for every installation, never the Client-ID or the Client-Secret. The key of each template must be unique; JSON Schema cannot check this, the plugin skips a template with a key that is already used.

$schema.description: Link to this schema, for editors. Ignored by the plugin.

templates.description: The templates. The dropdown is sorted by name, not by this order.

template.description: One template. All fields except "key" and "name" are optional: a missing field is emptied when the template is applied, "scopes" falls back to "openid email profile" and "button_color" to the neutral gray #6B7280.

name.description: Shown in the dropdown and filled into the field "Name". The dropdown is sorted by it.

slug.description: Part of the URLs of the provider, e.g. /oidc/<slug>/callback.

issuer.description: Issuer URL of the provider, exactly as in its discovery document (/.well-known/openid-configuration).

scopes.description: Scopes, separated by spaces. Must contain "openid".

extra_authorize_params.description: Additional parameters for the authorization URL, as a JSON object, either directly or as a string that contains the JSON object.

button_label.description: Label of the login button ("Anmelden mit <label>"). Without it, the name is used.

button_color.description: Background color of the login button as #RRGGBB. Missing or invalid: the neutral gray #6B7280.

icon.description: Classes of a free Font Awesome icon.

console_url.description: Developer console of the provider, where the admin creates the application and gets Client-ID and Client-Secret. Shown as a link after the template is applied.
